events.title: Flash Flood near North Branch
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Sullivan County. A partially submerged vehicle was found in the North Branch Callicoon Creek at around 7 AM EDT on July 29th. Further investigation indicated that the vehicle was traveling northbound along a road parallel to the creek and struck a telephone pole before crashing into the creek. The deceased driver was located several hours later approximately 2.5 miles downstream. Specific cause of death is unknown at this time, however, widespread flooding was ongoing on Callicoon Creek and tributaries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Brooklyn
events.description: 1 death. Kings County. High standing water with water levels above tires on some cars with leaf debris in water with of occurrence estimated. One fatality was reported by FDNY as a men entered the basement to save his dog and drowned.

events.title: Tornado near Clark Mills
events.description: 3 deaths. Oneida County. A deadly pre-dawn tornado spun up at a kink in a line of severe thunderstorms in Clark Mills. Numerous trees were uprooted or snapped, with many of them on structures. Three homes were sliced or crushed by trees. Two residents were killed in one of the heavily-damaged homes, and a third fatality occurred on the crushed end of another residence. The tornado quickly became intense while traveling southwest |initially, and destroyed a historic grist mill along Oriskany Creek. The tornado then became absorbed into the southward motion of the line of thunderstorms, traveling along Kirkland Avenue…

events.title: Tornado near Canastota
events.description: 1 death. Madison County. Severe thunderstorms moved through the area during the mid afternoon of July 16, 2024. One of the storm cells moved through Canastota, NY producing a tornado touchdown between the Conrail railroad tracks and Barlow Street. The tornado was witnessed by town officials, residents and a video security camera on Canal Street as it moved to the east along Barlow and Railroad Streets. Severe damage occurred to multiple residences along Barlow Street with significant loss of roofs and roofing material as well as blowing out garage doors and windows. events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Horton
events.description: 1 death. Delaware County. A severe microburst with estimated wind speeds of up to 90 mph, occurred just northwest to north of Cooks Falls, NY near the southeastern edge of Delaware County. There was sporadic damage spread across southern Delaware County from the severe thunderstorm that tracked through the area late in the morning. However, straight-line wind damage was most concentrated in a microburst footprint that encompassed Cooks Hollow and Butternut Grove in the Beaver Kill Valley, and especially up the Russell Brook drainage for at least a mile. events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Manchester Bridge
events.description: 1 death. Dutchess County. A tree fell onto a mobile home on Feller Court killing an elderly man.

events.title: Flood near Leeds
events.description: 1 death. Greene County. Rising waters on the Catskill Creek flooded portions of Route 23B and Cauterskill Road near Leeds. A 76-year-old woman died after their vehicle was swept off Cauterskill Road due to flood waters after driving around a traffic barrier blocking the road.

events.title: Lightning near Clockville
events.description: 1 death. Madison County. Three construction workers were struck by lightning in the town of Lincoln while sheltering under a tree and waiting for a storm to pass. Unfortunately, all sustained injuries with one of them later passing away due to their injuries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Highland Mills
events.description: 1 death. Orange County. Woman found dead after being swept away by flood waters.

events.title: Flash Flood near Brooklyn
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Kings County. The body of a man in his 40s was found floating in the Gowanus Canal near 25th Street and Third Avenue in Greenwood Heights, Brooklyn on Thursday, September 2nd.

events.title: Flash Flood near Hollis
events.description: 2 deaths. Queens County. The wall of a basement apartment on 183rd Street near 90th Avenue in Jamaica, Queens collapsed due to flooding. A 43 year old woman and her 22 year old son were killed by the flood waters, while two others were rescued.

events.title: Flash Flood near Flushing
events.description: 1 death. Queens County. A 48 year old woman died when the basement of a home on Grand Central Parkway near the Horace Harding Expressway in Elmhurst flooded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Woodside
events.description: 3 deaths. Queens County. A 50 year old man, 48 year old woman, and 2 year old boy died when a basement apartment on 64th Street near Laurel Hill Boulevard in Elmhurst, Queens flooded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Brooklyn
events.description: 1 death. Kings County. A 66 year old man died when his basement apartment on Ridgewood Avenue near Autumn Avenue in Cypress Hills, Brooklyn flooded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Corona
events.description: 1 death. Queens County. An 86 year old woman died when her basement apartment on 84th Street near 55th Road in Elmhurst, Queens flooded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Auburndale
events.description: 3 deaths. Queens County. Two women and a man died when their basement apartment flooded on Peck Avenue near Kissena Boulevard in Flushing, Queens.

events.title: Flash Flood near Pelham Manor
events.description: 1 death. Westchester County. A 33 year old man from the Bronx died when he drove his vehicle into flood waters on South Columbus Avenue in Mount Vernon and became trapped.

events.title: Flash Flood near Tarrytown
events.description: 1 death. Westchester County. The body of a 69 year old man was found near Route 119 near the Mario Cuomo Bridge in Tarrytown not far from where his car was found submerged.

events.title: Flash Flood near Corona
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Queens County. An unidentified victim was found on the Grand Central Parkway near LaGuardia Airport inside a burned out car that had been rear ended. The fatality is believed to be flood related.

events.title: Flash Flood near Scarsdale
events.description: 1 death. Westchester County. The body of a man was found in Saxon Woods Park in White Plains after he exited his stranded car and was swept away by flood waters.

events.title: Flash Flood near Country Ridge Estate
events.description: 2 deaths. Westchester County. An elderly couple's vehicle was found pinned against a utility pole at the intersection of Lincoln Avenue and Brookside Way in Rye Brook. The couple are believed to have been swept away from their vehicle and down Blind Brook Creek and drowned.

events.title: Flash Flood near Freeman
events.description: 1 death. Steuben County. A 31-year-old mother of one was killed when flood waters forced her car from State Route 417 in Steuben County on Wednesday night. The woman was driving a Ford Escape when severe flash flooding compromised the road, and forced the vehicle off the roadway between South Addison and Woodhull and into the Canisteo River. She was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Lightning near Wakefield
events.description: 1 death. Bronx County. Six people were struck by lightning at Orchard Beach. They were all transported to the hospital. One of them, a 13-year-old boy died due to his injuries.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ushers
events.description: 1 death. Saratoga County. A pine tree fell onto a car and resulted in a fatality.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Arthursburg
events.description: 1 death. Dutchess County. A tree was downed across the northbound lanes of the Taconic State Parkway at mile 43.4. The tree fell on a vehicle, killing a 73-year old male passenger.

events.title: Flash Flood near Norway
events.description: 1 death. Herkimer County. The shoulder of Military Road in Norway collapsed due to flood waters. An 82-year old man's vehicle became stuck with the driver's side wheels on the pavement, and the passenger side wheels in a ravine created by the floodwaters. The man died when he exited the vehicle and was swept away by floodwaters.

events.title: Lightning near San Remo
events.description: 1 death. Suffolk County. A person struck by lightning sheltering under a tree at Sunken Meadow Park resulting in one fatality.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Nanuet
events.description: 1 death. Rockland County. Tree fell on car on Red Schoolhouse Road killing an 80 year old woman inside.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Newburgh
events.description: 1 death. Orange County. Tree down on Robinson Avenue / Route 9 W near the New Windsor town line crushing a car. An 11 year old girl inside the car was killed.

events.title: Lightning near Spackenkill
events.description: 2 deaths. Dutchess County. Five people (four men and one woman) were struck by lightning in Mansion Square Park in Poughkeepsie during a thunderstorm. The five people were seated in park benches under a tree on the northern side of the park, when lightning struck the tree and traveled through the ground and into the benches. Three of the people were unresponsive immediately after the lightning strike and two would eventually die due to their injuries. Witnesses saw items burning near the people after the strike.

events.title: Lightning near Batavia
events.description: 2 deaths. Genesee County

events.title: Flash Flood near Coleville
events.description: 1 death. Onondaga County. Severe urban flash flooding occurred in the City of Syracuse. A man was swept to his death after stepping into an open manhole on East Fayette Street. Heavy rainfall caused the manhole cover to be blown off by excessive water pressure in the storm sewer system.

events.title: Dust Devil near Calverton
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Suffolk County. Low level instability and convergence along a sea breeze front might have produced a dust devil that resulted in the death of 1 Sky Diver, and injured another.

events.title: Tornado near Peterboro
events.description: 4 deaths. Madison County. A tornado touched down in Smithfield just 2 miles to the northeast of Peterboro. This EF2 tornado with a path length of 2.5 miles and a path width of 235 yard resulted in 4 fatalities in Smithfield. Three homes were destroyed and 5 additional homes sustained significant damage.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Oaks Corners
events.description: 2 deaths. Ontario County. Officials reported two people were killed when a tree fell on their car.
